name: State Farm
legalName: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company
notes: Site copyright footer and the privacy notice name State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company (Bloomington, IL; HQ One State Farm Plaza, Bloomington, IL 61710). The privacy notice lists State Farm Fire and Casualty Company and State Farm General Insurance Company among the affiliated companies; which entity writes each property line was not verified from a fetched page. Servicing is agent-centric: State Farm directs cancellation and billing questions to the customer's local agent rather than a central servicing line; calls to the main number route to a nearby agent during business hours and to a Customer Care Center representative after hours and on weekends.

The insurance FAQ page labels this same number as the toll-free rate-quote line and says business-hours calls go to a nearby agent while after-hours and weekend calls go to a Customer Care Center representative. No hours published on the fetched pages.

The insurance FAQ page answers 'What is the customer service phone number?' with 855-733-7333. This number appears only on that FAQ page; the contact page and cancellation page use 800-782-8332 instead. Conflict unresolved; test-dial before relying on it. No hours published.
Spanish-speaking representatives line per the insurance FAQ page. No hours published. Deaf/hard-of-hearing callers are directed to 711 or other relay services (contact page).
General 'Leave a comment' contact form linked from the contact page. Agent locator at https://www.statefarm.com/agent (contact page directs most servicing to the local agent).

Vanity decoded with keypad: S=7 F=3 C=2 L=5 A=2 I=4 M=6 -> 732-5246. Also used to reach a claim handler with questions if online/app messaging is not possible. Auto Glass Only claims have a separate line, 888-624-4410 (contact page; hours not stated). Health and life claim lines exist but are out of scope.
File a claim online; track an existing claim at https://www.statefarm.com/claims/check-existing-claim. Claim handler can be messaged online after filing.
State Farm mobile app: file and track claims, upload photos and documents, message the claim handler.

Bill-pay page: 'Call us, 24/7, at 800-440-0998'; listed under the Payment category on the contact page as '24/7 Phone line'. Caller must provide phone number and date of birth to access bill information; payments accepted by credit/debit card or bank account. For billing or payment questions and disputes State Farm directs customers to their local agent (help-center page), so this line is primarily for payments and bill information.
Guest pay (no login) using phone number and date of birth; logged-in account at statefarm.com shows bills and payment history. Payments can also be made in the mobile app.
Payment mailing address on the contact page: State Farm Insurance, PO Box 680001, Dallas, TX 75368-0001.
